steps.title: Hooks
steps.text: Small stickers with a QR code hang in the streets of Antwerp. We call them hooks. Each one holds a page from her diary.

steps.title: Keep your eyes open
steps.text: They hang anywhere on your way – on poles, walls, doors. Spot one, scan it, and a new chapter of her story is yours. You don’t need them to finish, but you’ll understand more.

steps.title: The map
steps.text: Solve a riddle and the map shows you the way: a line from where you are to the next place. Look up, not down – it’s a walk, not a race.

steps.title: Your stash
steps.text: Every piece of cloth and every diary page you find ends up in your stash. Open it with Collection, and tap something to turn it around.

steps.title: Scanning
steps.text: Found a hook, or a QR code at a location? Tap the round Scan button and point your camera at it.

steps.title: Riddles
steps.text: Sfumato texts you a riddle. The answer is always a place in Antwerp. Type its name in the chat – small typos are fine.

steps.title: Stuck?
steps.text: Every wrong answer gets you a hint. After three wrong answers Sfumato just tells you, so you can keep walking. No shame.
